name: Polywood Classic Adirondack Chair
description: Enjoy timeless outdoor comfort with this classic Adirondack chair, meticulously crafted from durable recycled plastics. It withstands the elements beautifully while helping to reduce landfill waste. A perfect blend of traditional design and modern sustainability.

name: Emeco 111 Navy Chair
description: This iconic chair is ingeniously manufactured using 111 recycled plastic bottles, giving new life to everyday waste. Its sturdy, lightweight frame offers a modern aesthetic perfect for any dining space. Experience true sustainable design without compromising on style.

name: Mater Ocean Chair
description: Transform your patio with this elegant chair made entirely from upcycled ocean plastics and discarded fishing nets. It features a sleek, minimalist silhouette that brings contemporary charm to your home. Support marine conservation with every comfortable seat.

name: Loll Designs Lollygagger Lounge
description: Relax in style with this vibrant lounge chair built from 100% recycled high-density milk jugs. Its playful, modern curves provide exceptional ergonomic support for hours of lounging. A brilliant example of how recycled materials can create premium furniture.

name: Ferm Living Desert Chair
description: Embrace mindful living with this stunning lounge chair featuring a textile seat woven from recycled PET bottles. The elegant powder-coated steel frame complements the soft, sustainable fabric beautifully. It is an ideal addition to both indoor and outdoor sanctuaries.
